# unifi_switch_stack (Data Source)

Fetches a single switch stack by id via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch a single switch stack by its UUID (Official API).
data "unifi_switch_stack" "core" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

# Each unit is one physical switch of the stack (controller 10.6.109+).
output "core_stack_units" {
  value = {
    for u in data.unifi_switch_stack.core.units : u.id => {
      mac_address = u.mac_address
      role        = u.role # ACTIVE_CONTROLLER, BACKUP_CONTROLLER or MEMBER
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the switch stack to look up.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `device_id` (String) The UUID of the device that represents the stack as a whole. Null when the controller does not report it (controllers before 10.6.109).
- `json` (String) The full switch stack record, including units and nested lags, serialized as a JSON string.
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the switch stack entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`).
- `name` (String) The switch stack name.
- `units` (Attributes List) The physical switches (units) that make up the stack. Requires a controller running 10.6.109 or later; older controllers report no units. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--units))

<a id="nestedatt--units"></a>
### Nested Schema for `units`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) The unit id within the stack (referenced by `unit_id` on switch-stack LAG members).
- `mac_address` (String) The MAC address of the unit.
- `order` (Number) The position of the unit in the stack. Null when not reported.
- `role` (String) The unit role: `ACTIVE_CONTROLLER`, `BACKUP_CONTROLLER` or `MEMBER`. Null when not reported.
